fields.label: Database Dialect
fields.help: The dialect of the Cloud Spanner Database.

fields.label: Ddl
fields.help: An optional list of DDL statements to run inside the database.

fields.label: Default Time Zone
fields.help: The default time zone for the database.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Deletion Protection
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the database.

fields.label: Enable Drop Protection
fields.help: Whether drop protection is enabled for this database.

fields.label: Instance
fields.help: The instance to create the database on.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: A unique identifier for the database, which cannot be changed after the instance is created.

fields.label: Version Retention Period
fields.help: The retention period for the database.

fields.label: KMS Key Name
fields.help: Fully qualified name of the KMS key to use to encrypt this database.

fields.label: KMS Key Names
fields.help: Fully qualified name of the KMS keys to use to encrypt this database.
